Bank Of Nova Scotia Boosted Its Vector Group LTD (VGR) Position by $1.64 Million; Stock Declined; Greatmark Investment Partners Has Cut Its Apple Com (AAPL) Holding by $325,984; Shares Rose
June 20, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Bank Of Nova Scotia increased its stake in Vector Group Ltd (VGR) by 221.8% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bank Of Nova Scotia bought 82,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 119,116 shares of the farming and seeds and milling company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.43 million, up from 37,016 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bank Of Nova Scotia who had been investing in Vector Group Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.58B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.49% or $0.09 during the last trading session, reaching $19.2. About 219,914 shares traded. Vector Group Ltd. (NYSE:VGR) has declined 7.15% since June 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.72% the S&P500. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc Com (AAPL) by 2.32% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc sold 1,952 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 82,343 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $13.82M, down from 84,295 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $916.38B market cap company. The stock increased 0.40% or $0.75 during the last trading session, reaching $186.44. About 6.73 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
